posts.title: Deploy Spring Boot Applications with Zero Downtime on Kubernetes
posts.description: Deploy your Spring Boot application to a Kubernetes cluster with zero downtime using a combination of termination grace period and context closed listener. Safely release changes to production at any time of the day without degrading user experience.
